name: phase2-edited-unsaved
eval: (async () => { const ed = window.__editor.editor; for (const s of ed.doc.allSolids()) { const b = ed.world.solidBounds(s); if (!b || s.entity) continue; const c = b.getCenter(b.min.clone()); if (Math.hypot(c.x, c.y) < 520 && b.max.z > 100 && b.max.z < 400) { for (const side of s.sides) { for (const p of side.plane) p.z += 96; side.material = 'DEV/DEV_MEASUREGENERIC01'; } s.commit(); } } ed.changed(); [...document.querySelectorAll('#sidebar button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Verify')).click(); })()
